landing.bodyText: An official website of the Florida State government. Florida Agency for Health Care Administration Latest News| Public Records| Contact Us Search Medicaid Health Quality Assurance Providers Agency Administration Find a Facility Careers Welcome to the Agency for Health Care Administration’s Dashboard Page. The Agency provides various kinds of data tools to the public. The Agency believes that access to clear, up-to-date, and transparent information is essential for making better-informed decisions. Our mission is to empower you with user-friendly data dashboards that provide valuable insights into Medicaid enrollment trends, Medicaid quality initiatives, financial data, and more. Our Goal To present complex and transparent health care data in easier-to-understand formats. Why It Matters Understanding health care data and trends can help you: Make better informed health choices Advocate for improved health care in your service areas Stay informed about public health-related issues impacting your community Medicaid Dashboards Health Plan Transparency Dashboard View health plan specific transparency data and metrics. Compare Medicaid Quality Initiatives Dashboards showing Potentially Preventable Events and Birth Outcomes data by Region, Health Plan, and Hospital. Compare Medicaid Financial Data Annual managed care health plan financial summary by transaction category. PACE Report View statistics for the Program for All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. Prior Authorization Metrics Florida Medicaid is required to annually report aggregated prior authorization metrics on our website in order to comply with the CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization Final Rule (CMS-0057-F). Other Dashboards View Licensed Bed Data View licensed beds by various metrics. Analyze Immigration Data View hospital admission totals and expenses on illegal alien hospital visits. Compare Hospital Financial Data Compare various hospital financial data and ratios over the last 10 years. Discover New Providers/Owners View new providers and owners by county. Explore Compliance Actions View compliance actions taken against State Medicaid Managed Care plans. View Malpractice Claims Data View malpractice claims by area office and facility type. semantics.bodyText: Financial Data Dashboard Front Page Financial Position of Florida Hospitals by County Indigent Care and Profitability Hospital Payer and Patient Service Information Hospital Utilization and Charges by Payer Operations Florida Hospital Financial Data This interactive dashboard allows you to compare hospital data by County, Hospital, Type of Hospital and Payer. OVERVIEW OF HOSPITAL FINANCIAL DATA DASHBOARD Hospital Data Used: This dashboard is based on hospital-specific audited financial data submitted to the Agency for Health Care Administration. The report covers the most recent complete ten (10) years of data. Fiscal years include all reports with ending dates from January 1st to December 31st within the year indicated. Some hospitals have filed partial year reports due to fiscal year or ownership changes. In those cases, the data is combined in the year in which the report end dates occur. New fiscal year updates will be added no later than November of each year. For example, 2020 data will be available no later than November 2021. How do I use the Dashboard? The dashboard is designed to allow users to create their own view of interest and scale down or up to the level of data they are interested in. Start – To start, use the navigation pane at the top of the page and click on the tab that interest you. The data is presented at the statewide level for all years. The data is interactive and has instructions on each tab on how to use it. To get more detailed information you need to Select, Click, and/or Hover over the data. · Select – You will be prompted to select options from drop down menus for more detailed information. · Click – You can click on images such as maps and bar charts to change the display to show more detailed information. · Hover – You can hover over sections of the dashboard to get more detail or explanation on what you are seeing. If you get down to far into detail and want to go back to statewide simply refresh the browser or unclick and unselect your options to return back to the original view. Linked draft bill suggestions Specialty Pharmacy Class Visibility Act (draft) SUGGESTED BILL LANGUAGE · OPTIONS TO EXAMINE Medicaid Legislative Metrics Freshness Act (draft) Requires freshness and coverage-period labels whenever lagged benchmarks appear beside operational claims metrics. Surgical amendment style Draft template Medicaid Legislative Metrics Freshness Act (draft) Rural Network Adequacy Corrective Tools Act (draft) Specialty Pharmacy Class Visibility Act (draft) SECTION 1. Definitions. (1) "Legislative Medicaid metric" means an aggregate measure prepared for the General Assembly concerning Medicaid cost, utilization, outcomes, or managed-care performance. (2) "Lagged comparison" means a benchmark whose measurement period ends more than twelve (12) months before the operational claims period displayed beside it. SECTION 2. Freshness labeling duty. (1) Any legislative Medicaid metric display that places a lagged comparison beside an operational claims metric shall: (a) Display the service or measurement period; (b) Display the publication or refresh date; and (c) Display a plain-language freshness label selected from: Near current, Recent, Lagged, Historical, or Provisional. (2) Failure to label shall be treated as an incomplete metric for oversight purposes, not as a finding of program noncompliance. SECTION 3. No private right of action. This Act creates no private cause of action and does not alter Medicaid eligibility or benefits. Draft wording is examination material for legislative packaging. It is not legislative counsel, not introduced language, and not a recommendation to enact.
